stories.title: Local mechanic on preparations drivers should make before holiday travel
stories.summary: Michael Wald says business always sees a boost before Thanksgiving and Christmas.

stories.title: AG Dana Nessel launches annual consumer protection 'scampaign'
stories.summary: The goal of the "scampaign" is to help educate consumers through social media videos on common warning signs so they don't fall victim to scams.

stories.title: 'Give work visas to everybody': Grand Rapids mayor's immigration comments go viral
stories.summary: Mayor David LaGrand was discussing a 12-page draft ordinance proposal created with the ACLU of Michigan last week when he shared his thoughts on ICE and Immigration.

stories.title: MillerKnoll sues online furniture retailer for trademark infringement
stories.summary: The lawsuit alleges that The Essential, an online furniture retailer, engaged in unfair competition and deceptive trade practices.

stories.title: Muskegon Museum of Art's Festival of Trees returns
stories.summary: The exhibit runs from Nov. 25 to Jan. 3 and doubles as a fundraiser for the Muskegon Museum of Art.

stories.title: Operation Handshake honors military members, veterans returning home for the holidays
stories.summary: Operation Handshake at Gerald R. Ford International Airport welcomes returning military members and veterans as they travel.

stories.title: Hunter finds missing woman's personal items; sheriff's office finds human remains shortly after
stories.summary: Jennifer McCormick, 55, went missing in May. On Wednesday, a hunter found some of her personal belongings. Kalamazoo deputies found human remains soon after.

stories.title: FBI turns to deceased suspect’s phone and laptop for clues in several West Michigan art heists
stories.summary: The FBI wants to search a deceased suspect’s phone and laptop to learn whether anyone else was involved in at least two West Michigan art thefts.

stories.title: DTE places 350 lineworkers on call ahead of Thanksgiving weather
stories.summary: DTE has placed 350 workers on call to respond to electrical system issues that could be caused by severe weather.

stories.title: Kalamazoo issues water boil advisory
stories.summary: Both sides of Grace Road from Cherokee Street to Nichols Road are under a water boil advisory due to a water main break.

stories.title: Laketown Township to unveil new beach stairs
stories.summary: Laketown Township unveils new aluminum beach stairs to enhance dune access. A ribbon-cutting is on Dec. 5.

stories.title: Need a last-minute shopping trip? Here's what's open in West Michigan on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: If you find yourself missing a key ingredient while you prep your Thanksgiving dinner, you have options in West Michigan.
